summarization:
The smartphone UI screen is from an app called "ALIVE ONESCAN PRO." The main content of the screen indicates that the app was unable to find any close matches for the scanned image. It provides the following instructions to improve the scanning process:

- Focus on the image so that it fills the camera screen.
- Hold your phone still and scan.
- Ensure that lighting conditions are sufficient.

There is a prominent "Try Again" button for the user to attempt the scan again. Below this, there is a section titled "Most Viewed Videos," displaying a horizontal scrollable list of video thumbnails with brief titles underneath each thumbnail.
